data.title: Remove migrate command
data.body:
## Goal

Remove the `migrate` command since 0.1.0 is the first release and there's no old markdown format to migrate from.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Remove `src/commands/migrate.rs`
- [ ] Remove `Migrate` variant from `Commands` enum in `main.rs`
- [ ] Remove `migrate` from `mod.rs` exports
- [ ] Remove from CHANGELOG if present
- [ ] Update any documentation that mentions migrate

## Context

The migrate command was used during development to convert from an earlier markdown-based bug format to JSONL event logs. With 0.1.0 being the first public release, no users will have the old format to migrate from.
